The '''Jrade School Board''' presumably controlled the schools in the [[Jrade District/Legends|Jrade District]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In 22 BBY, the Jrade School Board was surprised to find [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]] in the possession of two students at public subadult school [[PSAS-5128]]. The school required all its students to undergo body and locker searches as a result.

==Behind the scenes==
The Jrade School Board only appeared in an article in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 53|Vol. 531 #53]] of the [[in-universe]] website [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]]. The issue was released on [[April 25]], [[2002]].
